notes: Dell-style look and simpler Settings. New SupportAssist theme (Settings → General → Theme) repaints Helix in Dell blue with white cards, soft shadows and rounded pills; Overview gets a big device-hero card showing your PC model, CPU, RAM, OS and a health status pill. Settings is now one Essentials section by default with everything else folded under Advanced (8 cards collapsed) so the first-time view is calmer. Startup Apps page gets a 'What is it?' column: catalog hit returns an instant one-liner and keep/optional/safe-to-disable verdict; unknown entries fall back to the local 3B model when AI is enabled. Narrate-only — the Disable button remains the only path that touches the registry. XSS pass: upgraded esc() to a full 5-char escape, routed boost process names and all openPath onclicks through data attributes so backend-sourced strings can never break out of the attribute into JS. Keeps every 1.1.4 security invariant (trusted host, SHA256-verified download, 128 MiB cap, no visible terminals, below-normal CPU and I/O priority).
